qualification: conditional proxy: zonal paleolatitude climate, not a simulated paleoclimate

arid_belt.interval_kind: declared zonal classification support, not confidence interval
arid_belt.conditions: Earth-like circulation approximation in planet body-fixed frame; hemispheres symmetric; thresholds are project choices around the literature's approximately 30 degree descending belt

temporal_support: Use the recorded step-end carrier position used by the native deposition operation. Entire formation interval must have contiguous recorded steps. No extrapolation, present-day substitution, or continuous-path claim. Latitude range is sampled min/max, not an uncertainty bound between steps.

oxidation.conditions: 3 fluvial interpreted as subaerial; 4 lacustrine, 6 shelf, 7 deep marine, 9 swamp treated as reducing. These are coarse scenario classes, not measured oxygen fugacity; real lakes and seas need not be reducing. Native v0 has no eolian or alluvial code; never invent one. Deltaic and evaporitic alone do not establish redox.

uncomputed.reason: No recorded quantitative forcing, coast-distance history, redox chemistry or later fluid/bleaching history. Unknown preservation cannot be asserted false.

redbed_policy: Only quartz sandstone in the arid belt with oxidizing support, supported grade/burial and independently supported no-bleaching history may select redbed_v1. No substitute realization for humid or reducing settings. C7 preservation is absent, so eligibility and an actual resolved material are separate outcomes.

references.supports: Dry descending subtropics near 30 degrees; equatorial and midlatitude rising wet belts; polar circulation. Does not establish fixed 15/35 thresholds or this planet's paleoclimate.
Early iron-oxide coatings and later removal by reducing fluids; qualitative colour variation. No numeric matched Lab standard.

proper_later_fix: Climate-enabled C8 with passive per-deposition carrier position, climate, environment and subsequent alteration history. New physical recipe. design decides C8; this proxy does not launch it.
